description: Generate one or more UK 90-ball bingo cards. Each card is a 3-row by 9-column grid holding 15 numbers, 5 per row, with each column drawing from its own decade (1 to 9, 10 to 19, and so on up to 80 to 90). Blank squares are null. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bingo-card-generator/
